Title: MODEL CONFIGURATION UI
Summary: An operator-facing MODEL CONFIGURATION UI for the existing DevBridge AI subsystem. The UI lets the operator INSPECT which providers/routes/models and supported reasoning/capability options DevBridge may consider, and CONFIGURE operator policy (provider/model enablement and configuration status). Configuration/display only -- the UI never executes a provider/model, never makes a paid API call, never makes a network call, and AUTO_EXECUTION_ENABLED=FALSE. DB-M28 reuses (does NOT rebuild) DB-M14..M27 READ-ONLY: DB-M14 catalogue identity (gateway + underlying-model never collapsed), DB-M15 pricing reference (read-only authority), DB-M19 routing eligibility as the HARD capability gate (a model that fails a hard check stays CAPABILITY_MISMATCH even when enabled; the UI states 'Hard capability override: NO'), DB-M21 budget display-only, DB-M22 provider health READ-ONLY (no manual HEALTHY/circuit reset/AUTH_ERROR clear/failover), DB-M23 price-status table (LOCAL_COST_UNKNOWN never FREE), DB-M26 analytics (no duplicate dashboard), DB-M27 calculator for the VIEW COST ESTIMATE card (no duplicate cost formula). 10 sections: PROVIDERS / MODELS / ROUTES / REASONING (only NONE|LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|MAX from the contracts) / LOCAL MODELS (LOCAL != FREE) / OPENROUTER+GATEWAY / PRICING REFERENCE / ROUTING ELIGIBILITY (ELIGIBLE|DISABLED|CAPABILITY_MISMATCH|PRICING_UNKNOWN|PROVIDER_UNHEALTHY|CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE) / HEALTH STATUS (read-only) / SECURITY+SECRET STATUS (CONFIGURED|NOT_CONFIGURED|INVALID_CONFIGURATION|NO_SECRET_REQUIRED; values never rendered or logged, env-var NAME only). Persistence: validated-before-save, atomic (temp+Move-Item), read-back verified, schema/version preserved, only the operator's field changes, audit record with secret values redacted (SecretReference always in RedactedFields), live config byte-identical. S1-S55: UI opens + provider/model/route/reasoning/capability display, direct/gateway/local routes, LOCAL_COST_UNKNOWN + LOCAL is NOT FREE, OpenRouter gateway identity + underlying model preserved, pricing reference + unknown states, health read-only + not fabricatable, routing eligibility + disabled exclusion + capability-mismatch-not-toggleable + configuration-incomplete, secrets never rendered/logged + configured/not-configured status, config validation/persistence/read-back/schema-version/audit/secret-redaction, DB-M27 integration + no duplicate cost calculation, DB-M26 preserved (381/1 external S41), DB-M18.1 preserved (R45 external + R50 standalone-green), DB-M19/22/23 regressions green, no budget/pricing/provider-health/routing override, no AI execution, paid calls 0, network calls 0, canonical workbook byte-identical, Nexus source unchanged, Lane C UI byte-identical, solution build 0 errors, frozen files/config/workbook SHA-256 byte-identical.
